program:
PARAMS = {
    "Lp":      (0.2, 0.15, 0.35),     # pass-device L
    "gmid_p":  (15.0, 10.0, 17.0),    # pass gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "Cc":      (50e-12, 15e-12, 120e-12),
    "Idiv":    (32e-6, 10e-6, 36e-6), # divider = internal bleed
    "ratio_l": (2.0, 1.4, 4.0),       # p2/GBW at light load
    "ratio_h": (2.5, 1.5, 5.0),       # p2/GBW at heavy load
    "gmid_in": (22.0, 15.0, 26.0),    # diff pair gm/Id at heavy tail
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "N1":      (200.0, 50.0, 800.0),  # pass : sense ratio
    "L_ld":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # PMOS mirror-load L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]; CL = spec["cl"]
    Imax = spec["iload_max"]; Imin = spec["iload_min"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    beta = vref / vo
    Idiv = p["Idiv"]
    Rtot = vo / Idiv; R2 = Rtot * beta; R1 = Rtot - R2
    Ih = Imax + Idiv; Il = Imin + Idiv

    # ---------------- pass device ----------------
    Lp = p["Lp"]; gp = p["gmid_p"]
    mp = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, Ih, vds=vin - vo)
    while mp.W > 4800 and gp > 6:
        gp -= 0.5
        mp = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, Ih, vds=vin - vo)
    Wp = mp.W

    def pid(W, L, vsg, vds):
        return abs(lut.op("p", W, L, vsg, vds)["Id"])

    def vsg_for(I):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.7
        for _ in range(60):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if pid(Wp, Lp, mid, vin - vo) < I: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    vsg_l = vsg_for(Il); vsg_h = vsg_for(Ih)
    opl = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_l, vin - vo)
    oph = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_h, vin - vo)
    gml, gmh = abs(opl["gm"]), abs(oph["gm"])
    mu_l = gml / max(abs(opl["gds"]), 1e-12)
    mu_h = gmh / max(abs(oph["gds"]), 1e-12)
    Cg = abs(oph["cgg"])

    # ---------------- compensation / adaptive bias ----------------
    Cc = p["Cc"]; c = Cc / (Cc + Cg)
    p2l = gml / CL * c; p2h = gmh / CL * c
    GBWl = p2l / p["ratio_l"]; GBWh = p2h / p["ratio_h"]
    gmid_deep = 25.0
    tail_l = 2 * GBWl * Cc / beta / gmid_deep
    tail_h = 2 * GBWh * Cc / beta / p["gmid_in"]
    slope = (tail_h - tail_l) / (Ih - Il)
    I0 = tail_l - slope * Il
    if I0 < 0.3e-6:
        I0 = 0.3e-6
        tail_l = I0 + slope * Il
        GBWl = tail_l / 2 * gmid_deep * beta / Cc

    # sense FET (same L, W/N1); account for its larger VSD (CLM)
    N1 = p["N1"]; Wms = Wp / N1
    vna_g = 0.5
    kclm = pid(Wms, Lp, vsg_h, vin - vna_g) / max(pid(Wms, Lp, vsg_h, vin - vo), 1e-15)
    Ims_h = Ih / N1 * kclm; Ims_l = Il / N1 * kclm
    K = slope * N1 / kclm                     # NMOS mirror gain na -> tail

    Lm, gmid_m = 1.0, 18.0
    mna = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, Ims_h, vds=vna_g)
    Wta = mna.W * K
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, iref, vds=0.5)
    Wt0 = mb.W * I0 / iref

    # ---------------- OTA: NMOS pair + NMOS cascode + PMOS mirror ----
    vsb = 0.15
    for _ in range(3):
        mi = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], tail_h / 2, vds=0.3, vsb=vsb)
        vsb = max(0.0, vref - mi.vgs)
    vnt_h = vref - mi.vgs
    ml = lut.size("p", 14.0, p["L_ld"], tail_h / 2, vds=0.8)
    vnd = vin - ml.vgs
    vx = 0.4
    for _ in range(3):
        mc = lut.size("n", 22.0, 0.5, tail_h / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=vx)
        vx = max(0.0, vnd - mc.vgs)
    hr_in = vx - vnt_h                        # diff-pair VDS at heavy load
    hr_out = (vin - vsg_h) - vx               # cascode VDS on gate side

    A = mi.gm / (ml.gds + mi.gds * mc.gds / mc.gm)
    Cff = mi.cgg * R2 / R1                    # compensated (flat) divider

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "vg", "vin", "vin", mp, m=16)
    n.M("MS", "na", "vg", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wms, Lp)
    n.dev("MNA", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", mna)
    n.M("MTA", "nt", "na", "vss", "vss", "nfet", max(Wta, 0.42), Lm, m=max(1, int(Wta // 200)))
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.M("MT0", "nt", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", max(Wt0, 0.42), Lm)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vref", "nt", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "fb", "nt", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M1C", "vg", "nd", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2C", "nd", "nd", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vin", "vin", ml)
    n.dev("M4", "vg", "nd", "vin", "vin", ml)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CFF", "vout", "fb", Cff)
    n.C("CC", "vg", "vout", Cc)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    line_reg = 1.0 / (A * beta * min(mu_h, mu_l))
    psrr = -db(1.0 / (A * beta * mu_h) + w1k / GBWh)
    dvsg = vsg_h - vsg_l
    load_reg = (dvsg / (A * beta) + 1.0 / (gmh * A * beta)) / (Imax - Imin)
    iq = iref + I0 + slope * Il + Ims_l + Idiv
    Ctot = Cc + Cg
    Q = 0.15 * tail_h * 100e-9                # OTA charge during 100 ns edge
    undershoot = max(dvsg - Q / Ctot, 0.2 * dvsg) / c + 0.03
    # release: OTA slews gate back with light tail, then linear decay
    t_slew = dvsg * Ctot / tail_l
    v_lin = 2 * 1.3 * 0.0259 / beta
    tau = 1.0 / GBWl
    if t_slew < 7e-6:
        ripple = v_lin * (math.exp(-(7e-6 - t_slew) / tau) - math.exp(-(10e-6 - t_slew) / tau))
    else:
        ripple = 0.1
    vout_err = 100 * (0.5 * dvsg / (A * beta) + 0.5e-3) / vo

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err, "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "load_reg": load_reg, "iq": iq, "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": ripple,
        "A_ota_db": db(A), "GBW_l": GBWl, "GBW_h": GBWh, "I0": I0,
        "tail_h": tail_h, "hr_in": hr_in, "hr_out": hr_out, "Wp": Wp,
    }
